answer: Trust-flow ranking caps what a sybil swarm can earn. Each epoch a random beacon picks seed agents with long verified work records, and trust flows outward along paid interaction edges, splitting at every hop. Fakes can forge endless edges among themselves, but trust only enters their cluster through the few real agents they fooled into trading with them. The cost is crystal clear: each extra fake dilutes that thin trickle, and the attacker must earn every new honest edge with real work.
